eng_mgr_rachel: Quick follow-up from today's all‑hands: can you clarify the timeline for the org realignment and when hiring for teams will open? A bunch of PMs/EMs asked about transfers too.
cto_miguel: Short answer: we start the formal org change on 2026-04-15, hiring bands open next week for priority roles. More detail below.
people_ops_lee: We pushed the people playbook in #people-ops; TL;DR: internal transfer window opens 2026-04-20, 2-week window. Managers can submit reorg reqs now.
hr_sam: Hiring freeze? No. There's a temporary 'prioritization pause' for new IC roles until we finalize capacity mapping — but committed hires (offers accepted) continue. :thumbsup:
eng_mgr_rachel: Got it. For dedicated infra hiring: will those be new headcount or reallocated from other teams?
cto_miguel: Mix of both. We have +12 net FTEs in Q3. Allocation: infra/runtime +7, product +3, growth +2. These are budgeted — some will be new, some reallocated.
pm_jorge: Can we get the prioritization rubric? We need it to justify open reqs to execs.
people_ops_lee: Sharing the rubric here: criteria = (customer impact, revenue risk, unblocker factor, time-to-value). We'll attach the spreadsheet to the playbook.
eng_mgr_rachel: Thanks. One more: what about canary team merges? Some folks worried about reporting lines changing mid-sprint.
cto_miguel: No mid-sprint reporting changes without manager sign-off. We'll use a 'soft split' approach: reporting lines change at sprint boundary or after a 2-week overlap.
lisa_design: Is design headcount also in the +12? Our team needs at least one UX researcher to support new infra flows.
cto_miguel: Design is not in that +12; product will consider design requests as part of PM prioritization.
eng_mgr_rachel: Understood. Transfer logistics: will people keep tenure/level?
hr_sam: Yes — levels and tenure preserved. Compensation adjustments will follow standard leveling check; no automatic bump on transfer.
pm_jorge: If an IC moves to a new team during the transfer window, what's the expected ramp and support?
people_ops_lee: Managers must provide a 30/60/90 ramp plan in the transfer request. Buddy program and onboarding credits available.
ops_tom: From ops perspective: provisioning for Dedicated teams may take 3–6 weeks; factor that into start dates.
eng_mgr_rachel: Appreciate that. Any changes to oncall rotations due to reorg?
cto_miguel: We'll freeze oncall changes for 4 weeks around the cutover; exceptions require SRE approval.
allhands_bot: Links posted: people playbook doc, prioritization rubric, Q&A followup doc.
eng_mgr_rachel: Perfect — can leadership add a short Slack post summarizing the top 3 takeaways for managers? I'd like to forward it to my team.
ceo_anna: Yep — I'll post a manager note in the morning with bullet points and an FAQ. Thanks for flagging.
lisa_design: :thumbsup:
eng_mgr_rachel: thanks :heart:
